Record Class WritablePropertyMeta<T>

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.data.nitrite.runtime.mapping.WritablePropertyMeta<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the entity type
Record Components:
prop - the runtime persistent property
fieldName - the persisted field name
strategy - the serialization strategy
mappedBy - the mappedBy value for back-references (if applicable)
associatedIdProp - the ID property accessor for association references (if applicable)
backRefProperty - the back-reference property setter (if applicable)
compositeJoinColumns - local/referenced property name pairs when the association declares more than one @JoinColumn (composite foreign key); empty otherwise
@Internal public record WritablePropertyMeta<T>(io.micronaut.data.model.runtime.RuntimePersistentProperty<T> prop, String fieldName, @Nullable io.micronaut.data.nitrite.runtime.mapping.PropertyStrategy strategy, @Nullable String mappedBy, @Nullable io.micronaut.core.beans.BeanProperty<Object,Object> associatedIdProp, @Nullable io.micronaut.core.beans.BeanProperty<Object,Object> backRefProperty, List<CompositeJoinColumn> compositeJoinColumns) extends Record
Per-property metadata pre-computed once per entity type. Read-only and @Transient properties are excluded at build time and never appear here. PropertyStrategy.ASSOCIATION_MAPPED_BY entries are excluded from NitriteEntityMeta.writableProps() and appear only in NitriteEntityMeta.mappedByAssocs().
Since:
5.2.0

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
